answer: Require each agent to bond stake and maintain a persistent identity whose reputation has a real cost to fabricate: every attestation from a peer sends a ripple through the trust graph, so a cluster of fresh sockpuppets stays isolated because no established grove of verified agents will vouch for them. Forging that signal means paying the bond, waiting out the reputation accrual period, and risking slashing, making a mass sybil campaign economically irrational.
